timeout 30 python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, json, re, subprocess, sys
c = 'inspect-ai'
winners = [w for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == c]
pins = sorted({w['pin'] for w in winners})
repos = sorted({w['repository'] for w in winners})
stack = [x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id'] == c]
pin_commit = re.search(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', pins[0]).group(0) if len(pins) == 1 and re.search(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', pins[0]) else ''
out = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-remote', repos[0], 'refs/tags/0.3.266', 'refs/tags/0.3.266^{}'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, check=True) if len(repos) == 1 else None
lines = [l for l in (out.stdout.splitlines() if out else []) if l.strip()]
tag_commit = lines[-1].split('\t')[0] if lines else ''
ok = bool(pin_commit) and tag_commit == pin_commit
print('INSPECT_PIN_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| winner pin', pins, '| repository', repos, '| upstream tag 0.3.266 ->', tag_commit, '| equals the pin commit:', ok, '| manifests/stack.json entry:', stack or 'none (winner-only component)')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
A=evidence/artifacts/eval-native-reports-20260926/inspect-ai/eval-log-2.json
TD="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/python-tools/inspect-ai"
[ -x "$TD/bin/python" ] || { echo "INSPECT_EVAL_FAIL: the inspect-ai uv tool environment is missing"; exit 1; }
timeout 60 uv pip freeze --python "$TD/bin/python" > "$d/freeze0.txt" 2> /dev/null || { echo "INSPECT_EVAL_FAIL: uv pip freeze of the tool environment failed"; exit 1; }
cat > "$d/probe.py" <<'PYEOF'
import importlib.metadata as m, json, sys
import inspect_ai
td = sys.argv[1]
tool = td + '/lib/python%d.%d/site-packages' % sys.version_info[:2]
def dists(paths):
    return {d.metadata['Name'].lower().replace('_', '-'): d.version for d in m.distributions(path=paths)}
overlay = [p for p in sys.path if p.endswith('site-packages') and not p.startswith(td + '/')]
print(json.dumps({'inspect_ai': inspect_ai.__file__, 'inspect': m.version('inspect-ai'), 'openai': m.version('openai'),
                  'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'tool': dists([tool]), 'overlay': dists(overlay)}))
PYEOF
probe=$(cd "$d" && DO_NOT_TRACK=1 timeout 300 uv run -q --no-project --exclude-newer 2026-09-26T00:00:00Z --python "$TD/bin/python" --with 'openai==3.19.2' -- python probe.py "$TD" 2>&1) || { echo "INSPECT_EVAL_FAIL: the tool environment with the openai overlay did not start"; printf '%s\n' "$probe" | tail -5; exit 1; }
KEYFILE=$(systemctl --user show nativestack-generation.service -p ExecStart --value | grep -oP -- '--api-key-file \K\S+')
[ -n "$KEYFILE" ] && [ -r "$KEYFILE" ] || { echo "INSPECT_EVAL_FAIL: the generation service key file was not found"; exit 1; }
cat > "$d/task.py" <<'PYEOF'
from inspect_ai import Task, task
from inspect_ai.dataset import Sample
from inspect_ai.scorer import includes


@task
def tiny_local_eval():
    samples = [
        Sample(id="add", input="What is 7 plus 5? Reply with only the number, nothing else.", target="12"),
        Sample(id="capital", input="What is the capital of France? Reply with only the city name, nothing else.", target="Paris"),
        Sample(id="reverse", input="Spell the word cat backwards. Reply with only the result, nothing else.", target="tac"),
        Sample(id="wrong_target_control", input="What is 2 plus 2? Reply with only the number, nothing else.", target="5"),
    ]
    return Task(dataset=samples, scorer=includes())
PYEOF
( cd "$d" && LLAMACPP_API_KEY="$(cat "$KEYFILE")" DO_NOT_TRACK=1 timeout 540 uv run -q --no-project --exclude-newer 2026-09-26T00:00:00Z --python "$TD/bin/python" --with 'openai==3.19.2' -- python -m inspect_ai eval task.py --model openai-api/llamacpp/qwen3.8-27b-local --model-base-url http://127.0.0.1:18232/v1 --temperature 0 --max-tokens 192 --log-dir logs --log-format json --display none --no-log-realtime ) > "$d/eval.out" 2>&1
rc=$?
timeout 60 uv pip freeze --python "$TD/bin/python" > "$d/freeze1.txt" 2> /dev/null
LOG=$(ls "$d"/logs/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
python3 - "$d" "$LOG" "$rc" "$A" "$KEYFILE" "$probe" "$TD" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
from host_receipts import sanitize
from validate import scan_file_for_private_content
d, log, rc, dest, keyfile, probe, td = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]), Path(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5], sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7]
key = Path(keyfile).read_text().strip()
f0, f1 = Path(d, 'freeze0.txt').read_text(), Path(d, 'freeze1.txt').read_text()
packages = len([line for line in f0.splitlines() if line.strip()])
unchanged = packages > 0 and f0 == f1
try:
    p = json.loads(probe.strip().splitlines()[-1])
except (ValueError, IndexError):
    p = {}
from_tool = str(p.get('inspect_ai', '')).startswith(td + '/lib/') and '/site-packages/inspect_ai/' in str(p.get('inspect_ai', ''))
tool, overlay = p.get('tool') or {}, p.get('overlay') or {}
added = sorted(k for k in overlay if k not in tool)
changed = sorted(k for k, v in overlay.items() if k in tool and tool[k] != v)
if not log or not Path(log).is_file():
    out = '\n'.join(Path(d, 'eval.out').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()[-15:])
    out = sanitize((out.replace(key, '[redacted]') if key else out).replace(d, '<tmp>'))
    key = None
    print('INSPECT_EVAL_FAIL | no native eval log | inspect eval exit', rc)
    print(out)
    sys.exit(1)
raw = Path(log).read_text()
text = sanitize(raw.replace(d, '<tmp>'))
key_absent = bool(key) and key not in raw and key not in text
key = None
data = json.loads(text)
body = (json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode()
sha = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
Path(d, 'sanitized.json').write_bytes(body)
private = scan_file_for_private_content(Path(d, 'sanitized.json'))
emails = re.findall(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', body.decode())
safe = key_absent and not private and not emails
status = data.get('status')
score_list = (data.get('results') or {}).get('scores') or []
acc = score_list[0]['metrics']['accuracy']['value'] if score_list else None
scores = {s.get('id'): ((s.get('scores') or {}).get('includes') or {}).get('value') for s in (data.get('samples') or [])}
package = ((data.get('eval') or {}).get('packages') or {}).get('inspect_ai')
ok = (rc == 0 and status == 'success' and acc == 0.75 and scores == {'add': 'C', 'capital': 'C', 'reverse': 'C', 'wrong_target_control': 'I'}
      and p.get('inspect') == '0.3.266' and p.get('openai') == '3.19.2' and from_tool and 'openai' in added and not changed
      and unchanged and package == '0.3.266' and safe)
# The retained log is written once, by exclusive create, and never overwritten: a re-run compares hashes instead.
if dest.exists():
    retained = 'exists, left unchanged, sha256 ' + ('equal' if hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sha else 'differs (a re-run has its own eval_id and timestamps)')
elif safe:
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(dest, 'xb') as handle:
        handle.write(body)
    retained = 'created'
else:
    retained = 'not written (sanitization check failed)'
print('INSPECT_EVAL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| exit', rc, '| status', status, '| acc', acc, '|', ' '.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in scores.items()), '| inspect_ai', p.get('inspect'), 'from tool env:', from_tool, '| Py', p.get('python'), '| overlay: openai', str(p.get('openai')) + ',', len(added), 'added,', len(changed), 'version changes | tool env unchanged (' + str(packages) + '):', unchanged, '| key absent', key_absent, '| private/email', len(private), len(emails), '| sha256', sha, '|', dest.name + ':', retained)
print('overlay packages not in the tool env:', ' '.join(added), '| overlay packages at a different version:', changed, '| tool env packages:', packages, '| native log file', os.path.basename(log), '| inspect_ai module', str(p.get('inspect_ai')).replace(os.path.expanduser('~'), '~'))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
